caption:
Mango and Cream Overnight Oats
Serves 2
240 kcal | 10 grams protein per serving 

Ingredient: 
50 grams oats, i use quaker rolled oats
1 cup milk, amul forever 
1 tbsp chia seeds / sabja seeds
1 whole mango, i use alphonso 
1 sachet monk fruit 
2-3 tbsp greek yogurt, i use epigamia 
fresh cut mango pieces for topping

Method: 
-blend together the milk + chopped mango and add to your oats + monk fruit for sweetness if needed, this depends on how sweet your mango is
-add in chia / subja seeds for additional nutrient value
-leave overnight in the fridge
-in the morning, top with greek yogurt and fresh cut mango and enjoy :)
